scripts.dev: npm run build -w @solara/contracts && concurrently -k -n contracts,frontend,backend "npm run dev -w @solara/contracts" "npm run dev -w @solara/frontend" "npm run dev -w @solara/backend"
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run build -w @solara/contracts && concurrently -k "npm run dev -w @solara/contracts" "npm run dev -w @solara/frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build -w @solara/contracts && concurrently -k "npm run dev -w @solara/contracts" "npm run dev -w @solara/backend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @solara/contracts && npm run build -w @solara/backend && npm run build -w @solara/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @solara/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n frontend,backend "npm run start -w @solara/frontend" "npm run start -w @solara/backend"
scripts.test: npm run build -w @solara/contracts && npm run test -w @solara/backend
